market_question: Will Keisha Lance Bottoms win the 2026 Georgia Governor Democratic primary election?
reasoning: The market price of 94% for Bottoms is astronomically high given no candidate has officially declared and the primary remains over a year away. Even if she runs, rivals like Stacey Abrams (two-time nominee) would instantly become front-runners. A crowded field with better-known figures makes her true win probability far lower, roughly 22%.
evidence_points: Keisha Lance Bottoms has not formally announced a 2026 gubernatorial run.
Stacey Abrams lost the 2022 general election but remains the most prominent Democrat in Georgia and would likely clear the field or be a heavy favorite if she runs.
Primary dates are May 19, 2026, and historical Georgia Democratic primaries for open seats attract multiple credible candidates, making a 94% lock for one person unrealistic.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of Georgia politics (2022 gubernatorial election results, Abrams' candidacies, Bottoms' tenure as Atlanta mayor)
Current news indicating no declared candidates for 2026 Georgia Democratic primary
